integrity: The infinite classification is proved symbolically. The odd-exponent branch is excluded by an exact 2-adic valuation and size contradiction; the even-exponent branch is reduced to the square case and proved by coprime consecutive factors. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the ordinary base-two Cullen sequence. The square subcase was already public in the 2023 British Mathematical Olympiad; the new content assessed here is the completion from squares to all perfect powers. Equivalent informal observations may be difficult to index.
title: Perfect powers in the Cullen sequence
